'''Roop Gawash''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] member of the Gawash family, a family of workers during the [[Galactic War]], living in [[Talaos City]] on [[Makeb]] along with [[Fillan Gawash]] and [[Myrla Gawash]]. During the [[Conquest of Makeb]] in [[3638 BBY]] Talaos was placed under curfew with [[InterStellar Regulators]] patrolling the streets, while the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel]] paid the workers extra to stay inside their homes. When the planet became unstable due to mining of [[Isotope-5]] from its core, [[Groundquake/Legends|groundquakes]] began to spread across Makeb. [[Republic Medical Corps]] specialist [[Tefani]] tried to evacuate them, but Roop became convinced the Republic was trying to con him out of his credits and forbade his family to leave. Eventually, a Republic operative working for [[Shalim Avesta]] came along and convinced the Gawash family to evacuate, shortly before the building they were in was destroyed by a groundquake.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Roop Gawash appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel]]'' expansion, added to the game with Update 2.0.<ref name="SWTOR" />

===Gameplay alternatives===
The player has two dialogues options after Tefani leaves Roop's residence:
*The light side dialogue has the player promising the Republic would cover Tefani's lost wages to get him to evacuate.<ref name="SWTOR" />
*The dark side dialogue has the player take half of the Gawash family'ss credits, leaving Roop embittered.<ref name="SWTOR" />
